scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from an analytic stationary affine recurrence; exact-rational tests check derived formulas and finite simulations are diagnostics, not infinite proof. It has no independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Independent iid event removal fractions and between-event additions
Linear mass balance without within-storm input, dry-period decay, or rainfall-dependent removal
Correlations are by event count rather than calendar time
Pearson correlation requires nonzero load variance
Historical priority only relative to inspected sources; a highly relevant 2014 paper was not available in full
title: A sharp sign transition and universal correlation bounds for stormwater wash-off
